title: Kamishiro Rui — Troubled At Midnight〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Line: Neighborhood

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
How long has it been since we last cried so much?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: We should cool our faces off when we get home if we don't want them to swell up tomorrow.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
But I'm glad...
The four of us get to keep doing shows together.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Yes.
I'm also really glad.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Hey, don't you have more to say than just that...?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I'm listening. I wasn't trying to be curt.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Though, I was also thinking about something else.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Something else...?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe. About our show, of course.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: The anniversary show we'll be doing for Phoenix Wonderland will be our last as members of its cast.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: You really are a show maniac, huh?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Anyway, lemme guess, you just came up with an interesting idea for a stunt?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: No, actually... I was just thinking that we could change the ending slightly.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: After all, it's supposed to be about us.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yeah, true.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: So, what did you have...?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hm? A message...?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Oh, it's from Tsukasa.
“Can we meet a little earlier than usual tomorrow?”

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
I don't mind...
But what could this be about?
The next day
Wonder Stage

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Ah, thank you all for coming!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Geez... How are you able to shout like that so early in the morning?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Nene! Are you still feeling sleepy?!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Huh...?! Emu, why are you copying him?!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Because it looked like fun!!!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Hey, I wasn't finished speaking!!!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
So, Tsukasa!!!
Why did you ask us to gather so early?!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Ugh...! Stop being so obnoxious, you guys!!!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Ahem.
Now, as for why we're here.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: It's about “The Traveling Troupe”, the show we'll be doing for the anniversary show. I was thinking that we could change the ending a little.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: What?!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Hey, Rui...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
This is perfect.
I was also thinking yesterday about making the same suggestion.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Ah, I should expect no less from our director! I take it you also felt somewhat unsure about how it currently ends?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: You mean the line, “And they made shows together forever after”...?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes. As things stand, that ending is not entirely inaccurate.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: But I feel that there's a happy ending out there which reflects us better.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Like the one from the show that MEIKO and the others did for us.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Also, I was thinking...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: This show is going to be the last one we do as cast members of Phoenix Wonderland.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Emu's brothers also mentioned that they'll announce us leaving to become freelancers beforehand...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: So what if we changed things around a little to make it sound more like, “We'll be back bigger and better than before!” You know, for everyone there to see us...?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Oh, that's an amazing idea!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I was actually a little worried that some of the visitors would be sad to hear that they won't get to see us do shows anymore.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: But if we can tell them that we'll be back...!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Then, I believe we're in agreement.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Let's come up with a new happy ending for “The Traveling Troupe”.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa, Emu & Nene
rows.Line:
Yeah!
Okay!
